# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

All 6 conservation regression tests and the e2e conservation runner are fully implemented and passing. The tank_core test file (conservation_regression.rs) contains 6 separate named test functions with descriptive doc comments covering: closed-system grazing, closed-system feeding, closed-system mortality/senescence, trim-and-remove (export), trim-and-leave (in-tank transfer), and water change (open-system). Each test enables Detail-level tracing and dumps traces to /tmp on failure. The e2e runner (e2e_conservation.rs) in tank_harness runs all 6 scenarios, produces a formatted summary report with pass/fail and N/C delta magnitudes, and exits non-zero on any failure. Conservation tolerance is 1e-6 mg per tick. Formatting was applied via cargo fmt.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Explored codebase structure: workspace layout, engine, budget tracking, tracing, invariants, and all simulation systems (grazing, feeding, death/senescence, trimming, water change, nitrogen cycle)
2. [Completed] Verified conservation_regression.rs exists with 6 test functions: closed_system_grazing_conserves_n_and_c, closed_system_feeding_conserves_n_and_c, closed_system_mortality_senescence_conserves_n_and_c, trim_and_remove_exports_exact_amount, trim_and_leave_conserves_n_and_c, water_change_mass_balanced
3. [Completed] Verified e2e_conservation.rs exists with conservation_e2e_all_scenarios runner that executes all 6 scenarios, produces structured summary report, and exits non-zero on failure
4. [Completed] Verified budget_helpers.rs provides full assertion API: step_and_inspect, assert_n_conserved, assert_c_conserved, assert_per_tick_balanced, system_deltas, largest_mover, with TANK_BUDGET_DEBUG=1 support
5. [Completed] Compiled both test files successfully (cargo test --no-run)
6. [Completed] Ran all 6 conservation_regression tests — all passed with 0 N/C delta
7. [Completed] Ran e2e_conservation test — all 6 scenarios passed: grazing (dN=0, dC=0), feeding (dN=0, dC=0), mortality_senescence (dN=0, dC=0), trim_and_remove (dN=-38.5, dC=-240.6 — expected export), trim_and_leave (dN=0, dC=0), water_change (dN=+20.0, dC=-64.0 — expected import/export balance)
8. [Completed] Fixed formatting issues via cargo fmt (conservation_regression.rs had long field access chains that needed wrapping)
9. [Completed] Verified cargo clippy -D warnings passes for both tank_core and tank_harness with tests
10. [Completed] Verified cargo fmt --check passes after formatting fix
11. [Completed] Re-ran all conservation tests after formatting — all still pass

## Validation Evidence

- cargo test -p tank_core --test conservation_regression: 6 passed, 0 failed
- cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_conservation: 1 passed (conservation_e2e_all_scenarios runs all 6 scenarios), 0 failed
- E2E summary: grazing PASS dN=+0.000000000 dC=+0.000000000, feeding PASS dN=+0.000000000 dC=+0.000000000, mortality_senescence PASS dN=+0.000000000 dC=+0.000000000, trim_and_remove PASS dN=-38.500000000 dC=-240.625000000, trim_and_leave PASS dN=+0.000000000 dC=+0.000000000, water_change PASS dN=+20.000000000 dC=-64.000000000
- cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings: 0 warnings
- cargo clippy -p tank_harness --tests -- -D warnings: 0 warnings
- cargo fmt --check: no diff (clean)
- Tolerance verified at 1e-6 mg per tick for deterministic floating-point conservation
- Each test has descriptive doc comment explaining the conservation story
- Detail-level tracing enabled in all tests; failures dump trace to /tmp/tank_conservation_traces/<scenario>.jsonl
- Export actions (trim-and-remove, water change) show explicit net-negative budget entries, not unexplained mass loss
- Per-tick balance asserted via assert_per_tick_balanced for closed-system scenarios

## Outstanding Risks

- Pre-existing test failures in save_load.rs (save_load_with_active_cycle_state) and e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs (warm_room, medium_planted biofilter maturity) are unrelated to conservation tests but indicate other areas needing attention
- Conservation test files (conservation_regression.rs, e2e_conservation.rs) are currently untracked in git — need to be staged and committed
